message:
Hey friends! 🌟 I was just thinking about how frustrating it can be when the power goes out, especially when your phone or tech decides to go kaput at the worst possible moment. I found a really handy resource that walks you through some practical steps to prepare for those unexpected blackouts. It’s all about having a little plan in place so you can stay calm and collected when the lights go out. 

I think we could all use a reminder to gather some essentials and maybe even recharge our batteries—both literally and figuratively! What’s your go-to tip for staying cozy during a power outage?
